name: SO/ Sofitel Hua Hin
short_description: A 100-room design-forward beachfront resort in Cha-am (marketed as Hua Hin), designed by Duangrit Bunnag, with two pools and 8 exclusive SO Pool Villas.
ai_summary: SO/ Sofitel Hua Hin sits on Cha-am Beach, about 32km from central Hua Hin though marketed under the Hua Hin name, roughly 2.5 hours from Bangkok. Designed by renowned Thai architect Duangrit Bunnag, the 100-room resort adds 8 exclusive SO Pool Villas and two distinct swimming pools -- Chill, an adults-only lap pool by the Red Bar, and Active, a beach-facing pool with a shallow kids' area. Guests consistently praise the striking design and family-friendly kids' club, though a vocal minority report serious service breakdowns, so it's worth checking recent reviews closely before booking.

faqs.question: Is SO/ Sofitel Hua Hin actually in Hua Hin?
faqs.answer: Not quite -- it's located on Cha-am Beach, about 32km from central Hua Hin, though marketed under the Hua Hin name. It's worth factoring the actual location into travel plans before booking.

faqs.question: Does SO/ Sofitel Hua Hin have villas?
faqs.answer: Yes -- alongside 100 standard rooms, the resort offers 8 exclusive SO Pool Villas, part of a design by acclaimed Thai architect Duangrit Bunnag.
